## What's New in v1.6.8 — Calmed Emerald Palette & Direct In-App Update/Skip Prompt

### 🌿 Calmed Emerald Palette & Rich Neutrals
- **Three Emerald Shades:** Adopted `#047857` (Primary Emerald), `#059669` (Accent Emerald), and `#ECFDF5` (Soft Mint Tint).
- **Calmed Neutrals:** Slate off-white background (`#F8FAFC`), pure white card surfaces (`#FFFFFF`), dark charcoal body text (`#111827`), muted secondary text (`#6B7280`), and hairline neutral gray borders (`#E5E7EB`).
- **Softer Floating Navigation:** Active pill rendered in soft mint tint `#ECFDF5`, active icon in `#059669`, active text in `#047857`, paired with Apple-style soft drop shadow.
- **Visual Hero Telemetry:** Dark emerald status with small indicator dot (`● Active`), reserving bright emerald for the Runtime Pulse hero ring.

### 📲 In-App Direct Update Prompt
- **Direct Update Dialog (`ComposeUpdateDialog`):** Automatically checks for updates on launch and presents an in-app dialog with direct **Update Now** and **Skip for Now** options.
